subject: Focused development plan for Soojin — 6-week checkpoints
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T09:12:34-07:00
Subject: Focused development plan for Soojin — 6-week checkpoints

Team —

Thanks for taking the time for a quick sync today. Over the last two quarters I've noticed a pattern of missed timelines and lower code-review throughput on the inference-sharding project. I want to avoid an escalation path where things become formal, so I'm proposing a short, targeted support plan (6 weeks) with clear expectations and weekly checkpoints.

Attached is a compact first draft (soojin_development_plan_v1.pdf) — the main points are:
- Concrete deliverables for each sprint (small, measurable)
- Paired-work hours with a senior engineer twice weekly
- Specific acceptance criteria for pull requests and tests
- Weekly one-on-one check-ins (30 min) + a brief written progress note after each check-in

Laura/Monica: please confirm whether this approach aligns with People/HR best practices and if we should copy Vivek for visibility once the plan is finalized.

Soojin: this is meant to be supportive — we'll make adjustments if something here doesn't feel workable. Can you confirm you can attend the paired sessions and the weekly check-ins?

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

Attachments: soojin_development_plan_v1.pdf, recent_release_timeline.csv

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T11:03:05-07:00
Subject: Re: Focused development plan for Soojin — 6-week checkpoints

Jonas —

Thanks for being direct and for the proposed structure. I appreciate the pairing offer; I think having concrete acceptance criteria will help. I can commit to the paired hours and weekly 30-min check-ins. A couple quick notes:
- I want to flag that last month's context switch to the billing integration contributed to the backlog — I'll outline the blockers in the first check-in.
- Can we set paired sessions on Tuesday/Thursday afternoons? That works best with my calendar.

I'll review the attached draft and add comments in the doc.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Software Engineer
soojin.lee@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T08:25:47-07:00
Subject: Re: Focused development plan for Soojin — 6-week checkpoints

Jonas / Soojin —

This plan looks aligned with People best practice for an informal, supportive performance roadmap. A few HR notes:
- Document each weekly checkpoint with a 1–2 line summary and any agreed actions (HR may request these if later escalations are needed).
- If improvement is insufficient after the 6-week period, we may discuss next steps with a formal performance plan. The goal here is improvement, not punishment.
- Please avoid copying sensitive performance feedback into public threads — use the shared doc (link below) for notes.

I recommend copying Vivek for visibility only if the plan is not progressing after week 3. For now Monica and I can coordinate pairing mentors.

Laura Bennett
Head of People Ops
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Related: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcD_dev_plan_slee (internal notes)

Subject: Re: Focused development plan for Soojin — 6-week checkpoints

Thanks, Laura — noted on the documentation cadence. Monica, can you confirm mentor pairing (name + first available pairing slot) so I can finalize the schedule?

Soojin — I'm slotting our first check-in for Monday 2027-05-17 10:00am PT. Please add any blockers you want discussed; I'll bring a short list of focused deliverables for the first two weeks.

Jonas
